headword: {静脈注射|じょうみゃくちゅうしゃ}
reading: じょうみゃくちゅうしゃ

definitions.explanation: A medical procedure in which medication or fluid is delivered directly into a vein using a needle or catheter. One of the most common medical procedures encountered at hospitals and clinics.

examples.japanese: {静脈注射|じょうみゃくちゅうしゃ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{投与|とうよ}→投与：12894_touyo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The medication was administered by intravenous injection.

examples.japanese: ⟦{脱水症状|だっすいしょうじょう}→脱水症状：30114_dassuishoujou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ひどかった→ひどい：01097_hidoi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、{静脈注射|じょうみゃくちゅうしゃ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{点滴|てんてき}→点滴：10580_tenteki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けた→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
examples.english: The dehydration was severe, so I received an IV drip through an intravenous injection.

examples.japanese: ⟦{看護師|かんごし}→看護師：05055_kangoshi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{丁寧|ていねい}→丁寧：00896_teinei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{静脈注射|じょうみゃくちゅうしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{針|はり}→針：03566_hari⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{刺|さ}して→刺す：02111_sasu⟧⟦くれた→くれる：00724_kureru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦ほとんど→ほとんど：00847_hotondo⟧⟦{痛|いた}み→痛み：01795_itami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じなかった→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧。
examples.english: The nurse carefully inserted the IV needle, so I hardly felt any pain.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{静脈|じょうみゃく}→静脈：05858_joumyaku⟧ (vein) and ⟦{注射|ちゅうしゃ}→注射：01665_chuusha⟧ (injection). Often abbreviated to {静注|じょうちゅう} in medical settings. The English abbreviation IV (intravenous) is also used in Japanese medical contexts.

USAGE:
A practical medical term that anyone visiting a hospital in Japan may encounter. Distinguished from {皮下注射|ひかちゅうしゃ} (subcutaneous injection) and {筋肉注射|きんにくちゅうしゃ} (intramuscular injection) by the route of administration.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {静脈注射|じょうみゃくちゅうしゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{打|う}つ→打つ：01221_utsu⟧: to give an IV injection
- {静脈注射|じょうみゃくちゅうしゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧: to receive an IV injection
- {静脈注射|じょうみゃくちゅうしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{針|はり}→針：03566_hari⟧: IV needle
- {静脈注射|じょうみゃくちゅうしゃ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{投与|とうよ}→投与：12894_touyo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to administer by IV

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{点滴|てんてき}→点滴：10580_tenteki⟧: IV drip, infusion — continuous slow delivery of fluid into a vein, as opposed to a single injection
- {筋肉注射|きんにくちゅうしゃ}: intramuscular injection — injection into muscle tissue, common for vaccines
- {皮下注射|ひかちゅうしゃ}: subcutaneous injection — injection under the skin, used for insulin and some vaccines
- ⟦{注射|ちゅうしゃ}→注射：01665_chuusha⟧: injection, shot — the general term for any injection
